description: The camera's field of view modifier (fov, fovOld and the FOV Effects option, fovScale, in the state records): standing, walking, sprinting and stopping by letting go of forward; walking and sprinting with speed II, walking with slowness III; sprinting with the option at 0.5 and at 0, standing as it goes back to 1; a bow drawn for 30 ticks and shot, one drawn for 8 ticks and let go, one drawn with the option at 0.5; a spyglass held with the option at 0; creative flight taken off with a double-tapped jump, flown and sprint-flown, landed by survival mode.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
